But if they fail then you lose what was once given,

author: flynn_jennie_m
text:
For God's sake, now that I have found you out,

Do not let me wait for death to bring me back;
It is too late-a thousand years have passed
Since my eyes saw you—I know you would be glad

If we could only meet once more! Come then:

Our love was strong and pure when we first met
In this great city of mine, where the air
Is always so alive with hopes and desires.

author: john_cunningham
text: As we have met, you know that I am not without knowledge and under- standing ; therefore do not be affrighted by my words . 1 desire to speak plainly; what I shall say is not new; for I have heard it before from the mouths of many who came here with me, and still live amongst you :

Am I mad?
My mother said that my son, my daughter, who is now grown up; I can't understand why she was so stubborn and didn't want to have children until her death...

It's been twenty years since then, and when I think about it today, it seems to be true!
Why do people hate me so much because they know they are wrong?
I don't care if I live alone or die alone.

author: flynn_jennie_m
text:
My dearest son, I wish to tell you
Of things which we do not say and tell;
Of feelings which neither time nor space
Can ever change or ever can destroy.
Your father's death and mine has been the grief
Which fills our lives with sorrow but destroys
No thought of love, the purest and most deep
That grows within us day by day;
A love which gives us comfort each and every day
Through this sad world we must forever stray.

author: john_cunningham
text:
I saw thy head on a black plume,
And thou wert borne before my view
Like one who walks in a dream;

For I had no eyes to do thee right:
My heart was numb with despair.

author: john_keats

text:
Tanka Poem

In the garden, I felt like an outcast,
A lone bird that flew far and wide.
The beauty around me was so bright,
But my heart was heavy with pride.
I longed for companionship but found none.

Renga Poem

The cherry blossoms bloom in full glory,
Like petals floating on the breeze.
Their delicate pinkness fills the air,
As if nature's own song is being sung.
Each petal whispers a sweet melody,
An ode to spring's gentle embrace.

author: john_masefield
text:
The way you live is, after all,
The one thing that’s left to you;

So do not leave it blankly white
Or black with angry hate or blue
With bitter grief and pain.

It will come to some strange day
When nothing else can be done
But love your life away.

Mermaids with long and flowing hair,

Their voices carry songs that are rare,

They're not like you or me, they live beneath the sea,

And we wonder if they ever dream?

Are mermaids real, or just fantasy?

It's something I've never really seen before,

But sometimes I wish that I could be more,

Than human, to see what it would mean for me.

author: john_keats
text:
A lone leaf falls from its branch
To find a resting place on the ground
The world is changing around it
But it knows not where it's bound
Yet all the while it strives to survive
For some purpose greater than itself
It struggles against the wind
Which tries to blow it away
But as it floats downstream towards the sea
Its time has come to say goodbye
So farewell dear leaf my friend
Until we meet again somewhere far beyondI hope this answer helps you!

author: john_masefield
text:
"All that glitters is not gold,
And all things foul are fair in song;
But he who finds himself content,
His own worst enemy may be."

A man sits alone and reads his book,
But when he hears another's voice,
He sees it as no hindrance at all,
For with him he has chosen to rejoice.

author: kemp_harry_1883_1960
text:
A young man stands before his mother,
Clad only in his long red coat.
His face is pale and haggard; it's as though he were sick to death.

The old lady sighs as she hears him speak: "What brings you home? You
stayed away two days. What have you been doing?"

"I was hunting," says her son with pride. "And I got me three hares."

text: Mother, please don't go! I am scared of darkness without you. You are my best friend.

author: maynard_theodore
text:
The night is dark and chill,
With breezes chilling round;

And through my window falls
A streamlet from the wall ;

When far away I hear
My mother's sweet good-night —

And then I think she sings
For me her nightly song.

author: o_reilly_john_boyle_1844_1890
text:
In this great land, where are the homes

Of those who toil that we may roam?

Where is the place for him whose hands

Make music and make life a dance?

Toilers are few but their reward

Is not too much or less than good;

But the true worth of a toiler's share

Cannot be measured by his pay.

author: robert_browning
text:
The life is sweet and full of light,
And joy, like morn on mountain height;
But it hath many an hour of gloom,
That makes sad music through my room:

O! then, for comfort from above,
My soul looks up to Thee, O God!

Hiligaynon

The moon, full and shining bright,
Like a diamond on the sky's night;
She smiles at me from afar away,
Her beauty speaks to my heart today.

Ref: The moon shines down upon the land,
In her silver light I stand.
The stars sparkle like diamonds so fine,
And the moon above is mine.

In the heart of our village lay a small churchyard,
Where generations past had found their final rest,
Amongst tombstones old, weathered by time's hand.
A place where memories lingered on and peace did abound.

On solemn days we gathered here, to say goodbye,
To honour those who walked before us, brave and true,
We knelt beside the markers marking out their lie,
Each prayer whispered softly, as if spirits could hear too.

As dusk descended, shadows cast across the stone,
Creating silhouettes against the fading light,

author: robert_browning
text:
"Oh, no! I have only got half-a-crown left!"

The man who had been boasting about his wealth and luxury as he walked down the street was now very anxious to get some more money. He went into a pawnbroker's shop where there were many rich jewels lying on the counter. The shopman asked him what he wanted: "Nothing," said the man; but at once the jeweller knew that this man was not really in need of anything for himself but hoped to borrow some jewel which would repay its worth when sold again after a few months.

author: stephen_crane
text:
The Three Little Birds
By John Luther Long (1894)

The three little birdies in a tree
Their wings did clap with glee;
And I wonder what they were thinking so busily,
While sitting there all day long?

They thought they would have some fun
On Christmas Day for sure;
But it turned out quite different than ever before-
Instead of joy and laughter galore!

author: stothert_james_a
text:
In the midst of silence and the stillness of night,

We hear from heaven's portals the pealing hymns

Of many voices blending in harmony bright ;

And all that mortal life is for was made known —

The great redemption story sung by angels down;

How man may know Jesus Christ as God indeed,

For who can comprehend the vastness of space?

author: thomas_hardy
text:
IN AN old churchyard stands a tomb,
 Wherein I find my name and mine;

 And therein also these two lines: —

 Here lies John Smith, who died on June 17th,
      He gave his life to save your soul from sin;

 Therefore now we give him this stone,
       And pray God to grant you one like him.

author: william_wordsworth
text: The stars are like your eyes shining on the darkness. The sky lights up when you shine. As you light up the dark night, so does the moon. You reflect the light of the sun onto earth, just as we give light and warmth to others. Your beautiful sight shines across the sea. It lights up the land where people live. We can see this bright star from far away, even if they have never been close to us. This is how our country looks at its brightest side. Like me, they feel proud to see you because you represent their home.

For thy crown, sweet-blooming May,

 We shall give thee garlands gay;
 And to make our thanks more sure,
 We will take them back again:

 For we know that all things pure
 Shall be kept from loss or pain;
 But we cannot guess for aye
 How the rose may come away.
